intro: We do not publish a price list, because a copier quote that ignores what you actually print is how businesses end up paying for pages they never run. What we will do is tell you exactly how the number is built: the device, the term, the included page allowance, the cost per page in black and in color, and what happens at the end of the agreement. Every proposal from GBM shows those assumptions on the page. No minimum-page games, no allowance set artificially low so the overages do the earning, and no notice window you have to catch to avoid an automatic renewal.
notes: IT support is priced separately and flexibly: pay-as-you-go, or pre-paid blocks that are discounted, tiered by the number of hours purchased, and never expire. When the hours run out we renew you at the same level or move you up or down as you see fit. Ask about government and education purchasing contracts — GBM holds several.
